statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service was rendered without prior authorization.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42.
The diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to detect and correlate the symptomatic palpitations and dizziness with any underlying arrhythmic activity.
